title: How the heart pumps blood
intro: The heart is a muscle that pumps blood around the whole body.
summary: The right side pumps blood to the lungs and the left side pumps it to the body.
photo: a real human heart, dark red muscle, seen from the front, with thick blood vessels coming out of the top

parts.label: Heart
parts.say: The heart is a muscle about the size of a fist.

parts.label: Atria
parts.say: The two upper chambers receive blood coming back to the heart.

parts.label: Right ventricle
parts.say: The right ventricle pumps blood to the lungs to pick up oxygen.

parts.label: Left ventricle
parts.say: The thick left ventricle squeezes hard to push blood to the whole body.

parts.label: Blood to body
parts.say: The aorta carries oxygen rich blood out to the body.

parts.label: Blood to lungs
parts.say: The pulmonary artery carries blood with little oxygen to the lungs.
